capabilities: Answer questions using retrieved vault notes as context
Include the currently open note in full for discussion or summarizing
Suggest note edits with a diff preview to accept or reject
Create reusable skills triggered by message content
Configure and switch between multiple OpenAI-compatible models
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says community store availability is 'once published', with manual installation instructions as the alternative.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask questions of your vault with automatic retrieval of relevant notes as context for the answers.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API key (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Groq, etc.)

summary: Sidebar AI chat assistant that answers questions grounded in vault notes and can apply suggested note edits with a line-by-line diff review.
